package.name: safety_shield
package.description: The Guardrail's Safety Shield as a ROS 2 node: subscribes the VLA's body-frame 4-D action on /vla/action_4d (10 Hz), checks and repairs it against the signed policy, escalates through the grant's FSM, and publishes the post-Shield body-frame setpoint on /shield/setpoint for the mavlink_adapter package. Also packages the VLA stub node and the launch file that starts the stub, the Shield and the adapter together. The node code lives in the repository's sitl/ directory and guardrail/ package; the entry points here find it (GUARDRAIL_ROOT, or the source tree a symlink install points back to).
